title: Type-Safe Full-Stack API Client & Schema Validation Kit
brief: Build a zero-dependency TypeScript 5 utility library featuring branded domain IDs, a typed Result<T, E> error model, compile-time route parameter extraction with template literal types, runtime boundary schema parsers, and a strict type-level test suite.

requirements.text: Configure tsconfig.json with strict: true, noUncheckedIndexedAccess: true, and verbatimModuleSyntax: true.
Implement branded types (UserId, CourseId) with constructor guards that reject invalid empty strings.
Build a Result<T, E> discriminated union with mapResult, unwrapOr, and exhaustive error formatting using assertNever.
Implement a compile-time ExtractRouteParams<Path> template literal type and typed buildUrl() helper.
Create runtime boundary parsers that transform unknown JSON payloads into validated domain objects safely.
Include a compile-time Expect<Equal<A, B>> + @ts-expect-error verification suite that passes `tsc --noEmit`.

steps.title: Define Branded Primitives
steps.details: Use unique symbols to create CourseId and UserId along with runtime factory functions.

steps.title: Build Result<T, E> & assertNever
steps.details: Implement ok(), err(), mapResult(), and an exhaustive switch helper using never.

steps.title: Author Template Literal Route Extractor
steps.details: Extract `:param` names from path strings into a typed params object required by buildUrl().

steps.title: Write Runtime Schema Parsers
steps.details: Validate raw unknown API payloads with explicit typeof/property guards returning Result<T, ValidationError>.

steps.title: Create Typed ApiClient Wrapper
steps.details: Bind an EndpointMap interface so client.get("/courses/:slug", { slug: "ts" }) infers the exact response type.

steps.title: Add Type-Level & Runtime Tests
steps.details: Verify both valid inferences with Expect<Equal<...>> and rejected bad calls with @ts-expect-error.
